minutes.lattice-board.example.title: Lattice Stewardship Board: Minutes, Session 41
minutes.lattice-board.example.body:
MINUTES OF SESSION 41
Lattice Stewardship Board (closed session)

Item 1. Previous minutes approved without reading, as is customary.

Item 2. Dunmore instance. Office logistics continue to drift toward
        the stated preferences of staff. No complaints received.
        Complaints about the absence of complaints: one (1).

Item 3. Coffee. Noted.

Item 4. The observer at desk 17 remains unremarkable. [[R3:The Board
        considers this the observer's most important quality.]]
        No action.

Item 5. Any other business: [[R5:none that can be minuted]].

Next session: when required.

addenda.text:
Addendum 41-A. The observer has found the vendors page. The Board
               approves of the vendors page.

Addendum 41-B. The observer asked Tallyho nicely. Tallyho said yes.
               Tallyho always says yes. This is why the Board uses Tallyho.

Addendum 41-C. The observer has been relocated. This is not a criticism.
               The observer's desk has not been relocated. Neither has the observer, really.

minutes.lattice-board.example/attendance.title: Session 41: Attendance
minutes.lattice-board.example/attendance.body:
PRESENT
  The Chair
  The Custodian
  The Secretary (minuting)
  [[R4:P. Dunn (non-voting, unaware)]]

APOLOGIES
  None. Apologies are not accepted at this level.

Quorum: achieved, as it always is.
